story: As a content owner, I want to submit a translation request in one form so I stop chasing people over email.
successMetric: Time to submit a request is under 2 minutes.

story: As a content owner, I want to see each request's status so I know when content is ready.
successMetric: Any request's status is visible in 1 click from the dashboard.

story: As a reviewer, I want glossary terms flagged so translations stay consistent.
successMetric: 100% of approved glossary terms are flagged in submitted content.

story: As a translator, I want source text, context, and approved terms in one workspace so I get it right the first time.
successMetric: Source text, screenshot, and approved terms are all visible in the job workspace.

story: As a platform admin, I want to see volumes, turnaround, and spend in one place so I can spot bottlenecks and manage budget.
successMetric: Volume, turnaround, spend, and utilization are visible on one screen.

story: As a platform admin, I want to manage users and roles so the right people have the right access.
successMetric: Roles and reviewer assignments can be changed from the Users & Roles page.

story: As a product owner, I want requests tagged by source system so I can see which teams and integrations drive demand.
successMetric: Requests are filterable by source system (PIM, DAM, Web, Commerce).

story: As a product owner, I want overdue requests highlighted and filterable by language so I can unblock regional reviews early.
successMetric: Overdue requests are visible at a glance from the dashboard.
